name: PurpleForge Detection Coverage
description: Detection-as-Code verified test coverage for PurpleForge automated purple team pipeline

techniques.comment: Rule: Certutil URL Cache Download | Tuning: Excluded certificate enrollment (addstore, viewstore) and PKI auto-enrollment svchost operations. Certutil -urlcache -f for arbitrary file download is well-documented LOLBin behavior and warrants investigation.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded certificate enrollment (addstore, viewstore) and PKI auto-enrollment svchost operations. Certutil -urlcache -f for arbitrary file download is well-documented LOLBin behavior and warrants investigation.

techniques.comment: Rule: DNS Tunneling - High Entropy DNS Queries | Tuning: Excluded Microsoft, Google, Akamai, CloudFront CDN domains and OCSP/CRL lookups that naturally have long subdomains. The 30-character threshold balances sensitivity against CDN false positives.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: DNS Tunneling - High Entropy DNS Queries

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded Microsoft, Google, Akamai, CloudFront CDN domains and OCSP/CRL lookups that naturally have long subdomains. The 30-character threshold balances sensitivity against CDN false positives.

techniques.comment: Rule: Non-Browser Process Using Uncommon Network Port | Tuning: Excluded browsers, development tools (Node, VS Code, IntelliJ), and system services. Non-browser processes connecting to known C2 ports (4444, 1337, 31337) are strong indicators of compromise.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: Non-Browser Process Using Uncommon Network Port

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded browsers, development tools (Node, VS Code, IntelliJ), and system services. Non-browser processes connecting to known C2 ports (4444, 1337, 31337) are strong indicators of compromise.

techniques.comment: Rule: AS-REP Roasting - Pre-Authentication Disabled Ticket Request | Tuning: Excluded machine accounts and Azure AD Connect service accounts (MSOL_, AAD_) that may generate RC4 AS-REP traffic. User accounts with pre-auth disabled requesting RC4 tickets are strong AS-REP Roasting indicators.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: AS-REP Roasting - Pre-Authentication Disabled Ticket Request

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded machine accounts and Azure AD Connect service accounts (MSOL_, AAD_) that may generate RC4 AS-REP traffic. User accounts with pre-auth disabled requesting RC4 tickets are strong AS-REP Roasting indicators.

techniques.comment: Rule: Kerberoasting - RC4 Encrypted Service Ticket Request | Tuning: Excluded machine accounts (ending in $), krbtgt service, and computer service principals. RC4 (0x17) ticket requests from user accounts are strong indicators of Kerberoasting. Legacy RC4 applications should be documented and added to allow-list.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: Kerberoasting - RC4 Encrypted Service Ticket Request

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded machine accounts (ending in $), krbtgt service, and computer service principals. RC4 (0x17) ticket requests from user accounts are strong indicators of Kerberoasting. Legacy RC4 applications should be documented and added to allow-list.

techniques.comment: Rule: LSASS Memory Dump Access | Tuning: Excluded core system processes and Defender accessing lsass.exe. The 0x1410 access by svchost is normal AD authentication traffic. Any non-system process with high access rights to lsass warrants critical investigation.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded core system processes and Defender accessing lsass.exe. The 0x1410 access by svchost is normal AD authentication traffic. Any non-system process with high access rights to lsass warrants critical investigation.

techniques.comment: Rule: NTDS.dit Extraction via Volume Shadow Copy | Tuning: Excluded Veeam and wbadmin backup operations. NTDS.dit extraction outside scheduled backup windows is almost always malicious. Critical severity due to full domain compromise potential.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: NTDS.dit Extraction via Volume Shadow Copy

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded Veeam and wbadmin backup operations. NTDS.dit extraction outside scheduled backup windows is almost always malicious. Critical severity due to full domain compromise potential.

techniques.comment: Rule: Registry Save of SAM/SYSTEM Hives for Credential Extraction | Tuning: Excluded backup software (BackupExec). Registry hive export of SAM/SYSTEM is almost never legitimate on endpoints and warrants critical severity. Case-insensitive matching covers both uppercase and lowercase variants.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: Registry Save of SAM/SYSTEM Hives for Credential Extraction

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded backup software (BackupExec). Registry hive export of SAM/SYSTEM is almost never legitimate on endpoints and warrants critical severity. Case-insensitive matching covers both uppercase and lowercase variants.

techniques.comment:
Rule: AMSI Bypass via Reflection | Tuning: Excluded legitimate AMSI testing scripts. AMSI bypass via reflection is a well-known technique used by nearly all modern PowerShell-based attack frameworks (Covenant, Empire, CobaltStrike). Critical severity.
 || Rule: Windows Defender Real-Time Protection Disabled | Tuning: Excluded GPO script application and Intune management extensions that legitimately configure Defender settings. Interactive or script-driven Defender disablement warrants immediate investigation.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded legitimate AMSI testing scripts. AMSI bypass via reflection is a well-known technique used by nearly all modern PowerShell-based attack frameworks (Covenant, Empire, CobaltStrike). Critical severity.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded GPO script application and Intune management extensions that legitimately configure Defender settings. Interactive or script-driven Defender disablement warrants immediate investigation.

techniques.comment: Rule: Suspicious Rundll32 Proxy Execution | Tuning: Excluded normal shell32 Control Panel operations and print UI. Focused on suspicious DLL exports (comsvcs MiniDump, advpack, shdocvw), script protocols, and temporary file paths indicating malicious proxy execution.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded normal shell32 Control Panel operations and print UI. Focused on suspicious DLL exports (comsvcs MiniDump, advpack, shdocvw), script protocols, and temporary file paths indicating malicious proxy execution.

techniques.comment:
Rule: Security Event Log Cleared | Tuning: Only filtered SYSTEM account scheduled maintenance. Security log clearing is extremely rare in production and almost always malicious. Critical severity ensures immediate SOC investigation.
 || Rule: Event Log Cleared via wevtutil | Tuning: Only excluded SYSTEM-level scheduled task log rotation. Interactive or script-driven wevtutil cl operations warrant investigation. Pairs with Event ID 1102 rule for complete log-clearing coverage.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Only filtered SYSTEM account scheduled maintenance. Security log clearing is extremely rare in production and almost always malicious. Critical severity ensures immediate SOC investigation.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Only excluded SYSTEM-level scheduled task log rotation. Interactive or script-driven wevtutil cl operations warrant investigation. Pairs with Event ID 1102 rule for complete log-clearing coverage.

techniques.comment: Rule: Whoami Reconnaissance via cmd.exe | Tuning: Excluded SCCM remote agents and ManageEngine inventory scripts that routinely invoke whoami/systeminfo during compliance checks. Parent process constraint (cmd.exe) reduces noise from Explorer shell invocations.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded SCCM remote agents and ManageEngine inventory scripts that routinely invoke whoami/systeminfo during compliance checks. Parent process constraint (cmd.exe) reduces noise from Explorer shell invocations.

techniques.comment:
Rule: PowerShell Download Cradle Execution | Tuning: Filtered Chocolatey, winget, and VS Code update download patterns to suppress known FPs in developer workstations. Retained broad cradle coverage to catch obfuscated variants.
 || Rule: Suspicious PowerShell Encoded Command Execution | Tuning: Excluded SCCM (ccmexec.exe), Azure AD Connect, and Defender parent processes to eliminate baseline FPs observed in enterprise environments. The base64offset modifier catches encoded payloads regardless of character alignment.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Filtered Chocolatey, winget, and VS Code update download patterns to suppress known FPs in developer workstations. Retained broad cradle coverage to catch obfuscated variants.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded SCCM (ccmexec.exe), Azure AD Connect, and Defender parent processes to eliminate baseline FPs observed in enterprise environments. The base64offset modifier catches encoded payloads regardless of character alignment.

techniques.comment: Rule: WMI Process Creation via WMIC Command Line | Tuning: Excluded SCOM monitoring agents (MonitoringHost.exe, HealthService.exe) and machine account ($) WMI activity that generates high-volume baseline events. Focused on explicit 'process call create' syntax.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: WMI Process Creation via WMIC Command Line

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded SCOM monitoring agents (MonitoringHost.exe, HealthService.exe) and machine account ($) WMI activity that generates high-volume baseline events. Focused on explicit 'process call create' syntax.

techniques.comment: Rule: Ransomware Mass File Rename Activity | Tuning: Excluded legitimate encryption tools and system temp directories. Known ransomware extensions provide high-fidelity detection. The .purplelocked extension is specific to PurpleForge's safe ransomware simulator.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded legitimate encryption tools and system temp directories. Known ransomware extensions provide high-fidelity detection. The .purplelocked extension is specific to PurpleForge's safe ransomware simulator.

techniques.comment: Rule: Shadow Copy Deletion via vssadmin | Tuning: Excluded Veeam and Acronis backup agents that legitimately manage shadow copies. VSS deletion outside backup contexts is a critical ransomware indicator and the most reliable pre-encryption detection signal.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded Veeam and Acronis backup agents that legitimately manage shadow copies. VSS deletion outside backup contexts is a critical ransomware indicator and the most reliable pre-encryption detection signal.

techniques.comment:
Rule: Executable Dropped on Admin Share | Tuning: Excluded SCCM distribution (ccmsetup, ccmcache), GPO scripts, and WSUS staging directories. Executables dropped on admin shares outside these paths indicate unauthorized lateral movement.
 || Rule: PsExec Service Installation via SMB | Tuning: Excluded SolarWinds and PDQ Deploy administrative service installations. PSEXESVC and variants are strong indicators of PsExec lateral movement. Critical severity due to direct remote code execution capability.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded SCCM distribution (ccmsetup, ccmcache), GPO scripts, and WSUS staging directories. Executables dropped on admin shares outside these paths indicate unauthorized lateral movement.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded SolarWinds and PDQ Deploy administrative service installations. PSEXESVC and variants are strong indicators of PsExec lateral movement. Critical severity due to direct remote code execution capability.

techniques.comment: Rule: RDP Loopback Tunnel via Port Forwarding | Tuning: Excluded legitimate mstsc.exe launched from explorer.exe with /v: flag. Port forwarding to 3389 via netsh portproxy, SSH -L, plink, or chisel is highly suspicious and indicates tunneled RDP lateral movement.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: RDP Loopback Tunnel via Port Forwarding

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded legitimate mstsc.exe launched from explorer.exe with /v: flag. Port forwarding to 3389 via netsh portproxy, SSH -L, plink, or chisel is highly suspicious and indicates tunneled RDP lateral movement.

techniques.comment: Rule: WinRM Remote PowerShell Session Spawn | Tuning: Excluded DSC configuration management and Exchange Management Shell which legitimately spawn processes through WinRM. wsmprovhost.exe spawning reconnaissance or LOLBin processes outside these contexts is suspicious.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded DSC configuration management and Exchange Management Shell which legitimately spawn processes through WinRM. wsmprovhost.exe spawning reconnaissance or LOLBin processes outside these contexts is suspicious.

techniques.comment: Rule: New Local User Account Created | Tuning: Excluded domain join utilities (djoin.exe, netdom.exe), machine account names ending in $, and SCCM provisioning. Focused on net.exe /add to catch both interactive and scripted user creation.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded domain join utilities (djoin.exe, netdom.exe), machine account names ending in $, and SCCM provisioning. Focused on net.exe /add to catch both interactive and scripted user creation.

techniques.comment: Rule: Registry Run Key Persistence | Tuning: Excluded OneDriveSetup, SecurityHealth, Teams, Spotify, and corporate VPN auto-start registry entries. System processes (svchost, csrss) creating Run keys are also filtered as baseline OS behavior.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded OneDriveSetup, SecurityHealth, Teams, Spotify, and corporate VPN auto-start registry entries. System processes (svchost, csrss) creating Run keys are also filtered as baseline OS behavior.

techniques.comment: Rule: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation | Tuning: Filtered Windows Update orchestrator, Office C2R, and defrag maintenance tasks. Required both schtasks create AND suspicious action paths (Temp, Downloads, encoded commands, LOLBins) to reduce noise.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Filtered Windows Update orchestrator, Office C2R, and defrag maintenance tasks. Required both schtasks create AND suspicious action paths (Temp, Downloads, encoded commands, LOLBins) to reduce noise.

techniques.comment: Rule: WMI Event Subscription Persistence | Tuning: Excluded SCOM and ConfigMgr WMI event operations. WMI event subscription creation is rarely legitimate outside monitoring infrastructure, warranting critical severity.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded SCOM and ConfigMgr WMI event operations. WMI event subscription creation is rarely legitimate outside monitoring infrastructure, warranting critical severity.

techniques.comment: Rule: Suspicious Service Binary Path Modification | Tuning: Excluded MSI installers and TrustedInstaller service updates. Required both sc config binpath AND suspicious path indicators (Temp, AppData, script extensions) to minimize false positives from legitimate service updates.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded MSI installers and TrustedInstaller service updates. Required both sc config binpath AND suspicious path indicators (Temp, AppData, script extensions) to minimize false positives from legitimate service updates.

techniques.comment: Rule: Token Impersonation with SeDebugPrivilege or SeImpersonatePrivilege | Tuning: Excluded Defender and SYSTEM svchost operations. Named tools (JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer, etc.) provide strong signal even without command-line analysis. Command-line keywords catch Meterpreter and CobaltStrike commands.

metadata.name: Rule Title
metadata.value: Token Impersonation with SeDebugPrivilege or SeImpersonatePrivilege

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Excluded Defender and SYSTEM svchost operations. Named tools (JuicyPotato, PrintSpoofer, etc.) provide strong signal even without command-line analysis. Command-line keywords catch Meterpreter and CobaltStrike commands.

techniques.comment: Rule: UAC Bypass via Fodhelper.exe | Tuning: Only SystemSettings.exe is excluded as a legitimate fodhelper child. Any script interpreter spawned by fodhelper.exe is highly suspicious and warrants critical severity.

metadata.name: Tuning Notes
metadata.value: Only SystemSettings.exe is excluded as a legitimate fodhelper child. Any script interpreter spawned by fodhelper.exe is highly suspicious and warrants critical severity.
